udp2raw_udpspeeder.purpose: V2.1 unordered weak-network product baseline and regression oracle; do not float versions
udp2raw_udpspeeder.topology: upper UDP payload -> UDPspeeder FEC -> udp2raw FakeTCP -> public network -> udp2raw -> UDPspeeder -> upper payload

udp2raw.notes: V2-M1 qualification used classic faketcp with upstream -a RST rules on both client and server; Windows candidate remains a future platform gate.

historical_reference.profile: 50 ms RTT, 200 x 256 B, window 32, warmed, 3 seeds, forward FEC-shard loss 0/1/2/3/5/8/10/12/15%
historical_reference.result: 100% delivery and approximately 71 ms p99 across all tested loss levels

v2_m1_local_qualification.environment: isolated unshare -Urn user+network namespace; loopback; upstream udp2raw -a RST rules on both endpoints via iptables-nft
v2_m1_local_qualification.profile: 50 ms RTT, 200 x 256 B, window 32, 64-packet serial warmup, 3 seeds, forward FEC-shard loss 0/1/5/10/15%, UDPspeeder mode0 timeout8, 20:10 and 20:20

udp2raw_udpspeeder.qualification_rule: V2-M1 is satisfied for the exact pinned one-lane classic FakeTCP/FEC baseline. V2-M2 may insert only the ADR-0003 DTLS 1.3 security shim; custom FEC, two lanes, kernel-anchor work, native session/TUN features and Auto remain gated.
